overview.description: The Grayscale Chainlink Trust ETF (GLNK) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long link, short usd currency. The fund is passively invested in LINK, Chainlinks native token. The investment objective is to provide the value of LINK, net of staking rewards, fees, expenses and other liabilities GLNK was launched on Dec 2, 2025 and is issued by Grayscale.
